title: Deploying Zero Trust Branch in Mainland China

blocks.text: Zscaler supports mainland China proxy use for appliances with Zero Trust Branch version 8.1.2-P1 and later.

blocks.heading: Meeting Prerequisites for Mainland China Support

blocks.text: You must provide Zscaler with your appliance serial number as described in the following steps. Although you can do this after configuration, your appliance cannot connect to the proxy until it is authorized to do so.

blocks.item: Connect your appliance and power it on.
Log in with an admin account, via either a console cable or SSH, and note the serial number. No command is necessary, as the serial number appears when you log in.
Open a support ticket with Zscaler Support to provide the serial number and request that your appliance be supported for use in mainland China.

blocks.heading: Configuring the Appliance to Use the Connection Proxy for Mainland China

blocks.text: For mainland China deployment support, enable the connection proxy as described in the following steps. This dedicated proxy provides a premium connection to its cloud control plane, mitigating connection challenges associated with restricted network environments. For details, contact Zscaler Support.

blocks.item: Connect your appliance and power it on.
Log in with an admin account, via either a console cable or SSH, and enter zscaler-console.
Update the CNP virtual IP address if instructed to do so by Zscaler Support.
Update the web proxy and AS ports if instructed to do so by Zscaler Support.
If asked to confirm the IP address, enter y and press Enter. (Press Enter for any remaining prompts as needed.)

blocks.text: Your appliance is now configured for use in mainland China.
